CMOS one-hot resistor-string DAC
.include "circuit.spice"
.include "models.spice"
VDD vdd 0 3.3
VS0 s0 0 PULSE(0 3.3 20n 100p 100p 79.9n 400n)
VS1 s1 0 PULSE(0 3.3 120n 100p 100p 79.9n 400n)
VS2 s2 0 PULSE(0 3.3 220n 100p 100p 79.9n 400n)
VS3 s3 0 PULSE(0 3.3 320n 100p 100p 79.9n 400n)
XDUT vdd 0 out s0 s1 s2 s3 astra_057_cmos_resistor_string_dac
.temp 27
.options method=gear reltol=1e-5
* @spec level0 range -0.02 0.02 unit=V
* @spec level1 range 1.08 1.12 unit=V
* @spec level2 range 2.18 2.22 unit=V
* @spec level3 range 3.28 3.32 unit=V
* @spec level4 range -0.02 0.02 unit=V
.control
set filetype=ascii
tran 100p 500n
meas tran level0 FIND v(out) AT=70n
meas tran level1 FIND v(out) AT=170n
meas tran level2 FIND v(out) AT=270n
meas tran level3 FIND v(out) AT=370n
meas tran level4 FIND v(out) AT=470n
write out.raw v(out) v(s0) v(s1) v(s2) v(s3)
quit
.endc
.end
